messages:
Josh: FYI inbound from Sales — FinCrunch wants us to serve 'Orion-13B-v3' in eu-west1 and ap-south1, pinned to v3, with quantized int8 variant for cost. They need SLA and data residency. Ticket: #54321

Anna: Can you paste the customer's exact requirements? Any export-control or license notes?

Josh: Copied from sales thread: "must be in EU + India, no logs leave region, prefer int8 if perf ok, willing to pay for dedicated capacity. Need version pin during rollouts and a rollback plan."

Taylor: Support update: customer tried hosted test and got 404 in ap-south1 — model not in catalog there; fallback routed to generic-13b and outputs were noisy. They flagged this as blocking their pilot.

Sam: Infra heads-up: ap-south1 currently has A10G nodes only. Our int8 path (Triton kernels + custom fused ops) was validated on A100/RTX6000 families. We need a quick compatibility check before offering int8 on A10G. Also KMS region linkage for India is not yet approved by Legal.

Anna: Proposed triage plan (P0/P1 split):
1) Feasibility spike (eng-runtime) to validate int8 inference on A10G and confirm latency/cost delta.
2) Legal/Compliance: export control + residency signoff for storing model artifacts and logs in ap-south1.
3) Catalog work: add artifact + metadata, create variant tag `orion-13b-v3-int8`, and pin v3 for this customer.
4) Rollout: canary in eu-west1, then ap-south1 behind feature flag + routing policy favoring eu-west1 until ap-south1 verified.
Estimated effort: 2 dev sprints for runtime + 1 sprint for infra/legal blockers.

Sam: Agree. Quick smoke script to validate locally then prod: ```python
# smoke perf check
run_eval(model='orion-13b-v3', device='a10g', quant='int8')
```

Anna: Acceptance criteria to create backlog ticket:
- Customer artifact uploaded and license verified
- Int8 latency/cost within 1.5x of fp16 baseline for 512 tokens
- Residency/privacy checklist signed off by Legal
- Canary rollout passes quality/regression tests and monitoring

Josh: I'll confirm with FinCrunch if they can wait for the E2E plan. They indicated they can take Dedicated if timing matches their GA.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline kicked for catalog build #2021 — artifact validation running.

Taylor: Marking ticket #54321 as P2 for now, linking to feature flag `catalog-pin-experimental`. Added support notes.

Anna: I'll open the product ticket (PROD-289) and assign to eng-runtime. Tagging @Sam for the spike and @Taylor for support playbook. Need an ETA by EOW so we can tell the customer. :thumbsup:

Josh: Thanks — looping FinCrunch and will update after their reply.
